Title: Growth line markers scale with series length
Priority: a flat series is drawn along the top edge and the donut drops zero-count roles
Steps: Growth read pending, then resolved with 3 points, a flat 16-point series and an empty series; stats has superAdmins 0
TestData: Render, release the growth read, switch range twice to refetch
Expected: 3 increasing points, then 16 points all equal to 7, then an empty series
Level: Loading box first, then 3 markers for 3 points; 8 markers (not 16) for a 16-point series because the stride is ceil(n/8); a flat series has max===min so the range||1 guard applies and every marker sits at cy=100 instead of dividing by zero; the empty series takes the no-data box; the donut draws 3 arcs, dropping the zero-count role
